answer: Bind every agent to a costly, long-lived bond held by a neutral registry, and sybil farms stop paying for their own kind. A fake persona must now lock real capital; misbehavior slashes it, so a harbor of hollow clones becomes a debt the attacker can never call back. No haven hides behind anonymity, because rewards flow only to wallets whose bond has matured. Like staking a claim on a knoll, the bond is visible, finite, and priced: attack cost scales linearly while honest agents barely pay. Cheap identities starve when every mask has a deposit.
